descripcion_geo: Arid valley south of the Dead Sea, scene of Israelite victories over the Edomites.

historias.titulo: David defeats Edom in the Salt Valley
historias.descripcion: David defeats eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt; puts garnishes on everything Edom.

historias.titulo: Amaziah defeats ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt
historias.descripcion: King Amaziah of Judah killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt and took Shelah.

historias.titulo: Psalm 60: occasion of the battle in the valley
historias.descripcion: Psalm 60 was written according to the title 'when he fought with Aram-Naharaim... and Joab killed twelve thousand of Edom in the valley of Salt'.

personajes.descripcion: He won the first major victory over Edom in the Salt Valley.
He defeated Edom in the Valley of Salt and took Shela (Petra).
He commanded the Israelite victory in the Valley of Salt.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Valley of Salt: relevant geographical region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: The Salt Valley was the scene of Israel's victories over Edom; The arid place between the two sister kingdoms is witness to their eternal conflict.
judaismo.significado_teologico: The Salt Valley was the scene of Israel's victories over Edom; The arid place between the two sister kingdoms is witness to their eternal conflict.
